newsitem.title: USA: Dow pares losses as bonds steady, Nasdaq firm.
newsitem.headline: Dow pares losses as bonds steady, Nasdaq firm.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks came back from session lows on Wednesday as the bond market steadied itself, while Nasdaq remained supported by a recovery in the technology sector.

The Dow industrial average was down around 21 points at 7290. The New York Stock Exchange lifted curbs on index-arbitrage trading shortly after they were set at around 1000 EDT/1400 GMT. The long bond was off 8/32 at 6.89 percent.
Nasdaq was higher, trading up around five points at 1390 as bargain hunters sought to buy bruised technology stocks. Bellwether Intel Corp was up 5/8 at 145-5/8.
